commitments.detail: to maintain the privacy of the investigation and resolution process
to return to their reporting line as soon as the investigation concludes
All communications during mediation and investigation will be kept confidential.
The company will provide a resolution plan that addresses the senior product manager's concerns without admitting liability.
All parties agree to keep the mediation discussions confidential.
The company commits to no retribution against the senior product manager during the investigation and mediation process.
All parties agree to keep the mediation discussions confidential.
The mediator shall not rely on any statements made during the mediation for any future legal proceedings.
